hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); [[ "$FILE" == *.ts ]] && node_modules/.bin/biome check --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); if [[ "$FILE" == src/domain/* ]]; then TEST=$(echo "$FILE" | sed 's|src/|tests/|' | sed 's|\.ts$|.test.ts|'); [[ -f "$TEST" ]] && node_modules/.bin/jest "$TEST" --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -15; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); if [[ "$FILE" == src/domain/* ]]; then VIOLATIONS=$(grep -E "from ['\"]\.\./(application|infrastructure|presentation|app)" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$VIOLATIONS" ]] && echo "⚠️  ARCHITECTURE VIOLATION in $FILE: domain imports from outer layer" && echo "$VIOLATIONS" || true; fi
